conventions.ids_sha256: sha256 of the sorted ids joined by newlines (brief 25)
conventions.composition: the two-pass mean (A6.2); SD ddof 1; IQR by linear interpolation (A6.11 (4))
conventions.line_scores: the rater's section-2 scores of the three statements, each the two-pass mean, in statement order; line_max is their maximum (S-Q); top_two_gap the largest minus the second largest
conventions.replace_share: A5.12: the share of the item's three statements whose op is replace (candidates by brief 20's checks-file method, control items by the payload op)
conventions.pooled_strata: A6.17.3: documents with fewer than 4 members pool into one stratum, on the stratum populations only; the full set keeps its document factor
conventions.net: net of A6.17.11's pair-rule drops (s1-populations-v0.json net_pair)
conventions.readers: brief 25's D_part and D_whole means over the two samples per reader (stratum-v0.json)
